summary: This PR adds a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the review agent on same-repo PRs and on manual dispatch. It also tightens ReadFileTool: it now refuses files git doesn't track, symlinks anywhere in the path, and files over 2 MB, and comes with tests for those cases. I checked resolveInRepo, runCommand and the run-record output, and found no bugs or security holes worth raising. The tracked-file check runs on the canonical path, not the raw string the model sent. The `--` separator and `--literal-pathspecs` stop the path being read as an option or a pattern. The workflow refuses fork PRs, sets minimal permissions and doesn't leave a git token in `.git/config`.
